articles.title: GLG Residence / Ximenes Leite Arquitetura
english: Completed in 2024 in Itupeva, Brazil, the GLG Residence showcases the unique architectural vision of Ximenes Leite Arquitetura. Situated within the Fazenda da Grama Condominium in São Paulo state, it reflects a harmonious relationship between structure and environment. This residence exemplifies modern design principles, integrating natural elements into its facade and layout.

The design philosophy behind the GLG Residence prioritizes sustainability and functionality. Large windows frame stunning views of the surrounding landscape, while the use of local materials enhances the local character of the area. Such decisions not only create aesthetic appeal but also promote energy efficiency.

In addition to its visual impact, the residence emphasizes open spaces and fluid indoor-outdoor transitions. These features not only enhance the living experience but also encourage social interaction among residents. The GLG Residence stands as a beacon of contemporary architecture that blends luxury with environmental consciousness.
chinese: GLG住宅於2024年在巴西伊圖佩瓦竣工，展現了Ximenes Leite Arquitectura獨特的建築視野。住宅坐落於聖保羅州的法干達德格拉瑪社區，反映出建築與環境之間的和諧關係。此住宅體現現代設計原則，將自然元素整合到外立面和佈局中。
GLG住宅的設計理念優先考慮可持續性和功能性。大型窗戶框住周圍景觀的壯觀視野，而當地材料的使用則增強了該地區的地方特色。這些決策不僅創造了美學吸引力，還促進了能源效率。
除了其視覺衝擊，該住宅強調開放空間和流暢的室內外過渡。這些特徵不僅豐富了居住體驗，還鼓勵居民之間的社交互動。GLG住宅作為當代建築的燈塔，將奢華與環境意識相融合。

articles.title: Exhibition marks 25 years of "incredible" Princeton Media + Modernity seminar
english: An exhibition celebrating the 25th anniversary of the Program of Media + Modernity has been installed at Princeton University's architecture school. Curated by Beatriz Colomina, along with Foivos Geralis and Antonio Cantero, the exhibition traces the history of interdisciplinary work linking architecture and media through innovative seminar formats.

Founded in 2000, the Program of Media + Modernity focuses on the convergence of architecture and media, featuring discussions ranging from Le Corbusier to publications like Playboy. The exhibition's design, executed by Agency–Agency, employs a semi-transparent silver fabric that enhances the intimate atmosphere while showcasing seminar posters from the past.

The exhibition features not only visual elements but also interactive components like screens displaying seminar content. It emphasizes a non-hierarchical understanding of the program, making available a plethora of knowledge that illustrates its global impact through numerous exhibitions, films, and books.
chinese: 一個慶祝媒介與現代性計畫25週年的展覽已在普林斯頓大學的建築學院展出。由比阿特麗斯·科洛米納策劃，並與福伊沃斯·赫拉利斯和安東尼奧·坎特羅合作，本展覽追溯了連結建築與媒體的跨學科工作的歷史，透過創新的研討會形式進行.
成立於2000年的媒介與現代性計畫專注於建築與媒體的交匯，涉及從勒·柯布西耶到《花花公子》等出版物的討論。由Agency–Agency執行的展覽設計，使用半透明的銀色布料，增強了親密的氛圍，同時展示過去研討會的海報。
該展覽不僅包括視覺元素，還包含展示研討會內容的互動組件。它強調以非階層化的方式理解該計畫，並提供眾多知識，使人們了解其通過無數展覽、電影和書籍所產生的全球影響。

articles.title: open courtyards and evolving green facades turn hyderabad school campus into living forest
english: The Heartfulness International School in Hyderabad, India, exemplifies ecological design through its integration of architecture and landscape. Designed by Pentaspace Design Studio, the school is organized around ecological principles that support a harmonious learning environment connected to natural systems. By incorporating a developing forest, the design enhances the spatial experience and environmental performance, allowing vegetation to play an active role in shaping the campus.

Open courtyards serve as a central feature of the school, connecting classrooms while fostering a variety of activities such as play and informal learning. The wide corridors facilitate circulation, linking the enclosed classrooms with open-air spaces and promoting a dynamic learning atmosphere. These outdoor environments are essential for nurturing creativity and interaction among students.

The sustainable design measures include solar energy use, passive cooling strategies, and biodiversity support through ground-level planting and vertical gardens. This seamless integration of built form and landscape not only enhances the school's ecological footprint but also creates a nurturing framework that complements the educational experience. The emphasis on durable materials like concrete and glass ensures longevity while maintaining an adaptable space for evolving student activities.
chinese: 位於印度海得拉巴的心靈國際學校以其生態設計的理念而聞名，將建築與景觀巧妙結合。由Pentaspace設計工作室設計，該學校基於生態原則組織，支持與自然系統相聯結的和諧學習環境。通過將一個逐步發展的森林納入設計，使得營地的空間體驗和環境性能得到了提升，讓植被在塑造校園中發揮積極作用。
開放的庭院是學校的中央特徵，聯接教室並促進各種活動，例如玩耍和非正式學習。寬廣的走廊促進通行，鏈接封閉的教室與開放空間，營造出動態的學習氛圍。這些戶外環境對於培養學生的創造力與互動至關重要。
可持續設計措施包括使用太陽能、被動冷卻策略以及通過地面植栽和立體花園來支持生物多樣性。這種建築形態與景觀的無縫結合不僅增強了校園的生態足跡，還創造了一個能夠補充教育體驗的育人框架。對於耐用材料如混凝土和玻璃的強調確保了長期使用，同時保持了一個為學生活動持續演變而可調整的空間。
